newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Enviroserv in acquisition spree.
newsitem.headline: Enviroserv in acquisition spree.

text.p: Enviroserv Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had made a number of acquisitions in a bid to pursue the national expansion of its waste disposal and management business.
It said it had bought the outstanding 50 percent interest in its domestic waste business Wade Domestic Waste Managemnt Ltd from LTA Ltd for 31.5 million rand with effect from January 1, 1997.
Payment will be settled by the issue of 7.5 million new Enviroserv shares at 420 cents a share.

It had also bought the businesses of Waste-Tron Ltd and its related subisidaires for 8.6 million rand with effect from December 9, 1996. Payment will be made by the issue of 2,072 million new Enviroserv shares at 415 cents a share.

Enviroserv said it had also purchased the entire share capital and shareholders' claims from E. Card in Edward Card and Co Ltd for 2.3 million rand to be settled in cash. The transaction took effect on Movember 1, 1996.
The company said had the transactions been in effect for the year ended December 31, 1995 earnings per share would have increased by 18.96 perent to 18.34 cents from 15.42 cents.
